title: Jr Partnerships Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades

Projetar e manter soluções de monitoramento e telemetria para aplicações e infraestrutura.

Implementar observabilidade em ambientes serverless (Azure Functions, Logic Apps e App Services).

Automatizar provisionamento de recursos de observabilidade utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep ou ARM).

Integrar ferramentas de monitoramento com pipelines de CI/CD.

Implementar e acompanhar métricas DORA (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time, MTTR e Change Failure Rate).

Azure Monitor

Application Insights

Log Analytics

Container Insights

Observabilidade em ambientes Azure

Kubernetes / AKS

Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep ou ARM)

Integração com pipelines DevOps (CI/CD)

Azure Functions e Azure Logic Apps

Monitoramento de performance de aplicações (APM)

Métricas DORA e indicadores de confiabilidade


Formato de trabalho: Home office

title: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++



Resumo do Propósito da Função:

Esta função oferece uma empolgante posição de desenvolvimento de software na equipe de Engenharia, uma organização multicultural com times baseados na Europa e na América do Sul, responsável por pesquisar e desenvolver soluções de hardware e software para sistemas de medição de audiência utilizados globalmente.

Este profissional fará parte da equipe responsável pelos sistemas de correspondência de áudio desenvolvidos pelo IBOPE, que estão sendo implementados em diversos países. Esse sistema compara áudios coletados por dispositivos de medição dedicados com uma biblioteca de conteúdos de TV, utilizando a tecnologia proprietária de correspondência de áudio do IBOPE (técnica de fingerprinting).

O IBOPE possui sistemas desenvolvidos tanto para ambientes on-premises quanto em nuvem, utilizando uma abordagem agnóstica de cloud. Sua arquitetura é composta por diversas tecnologias de ponta, como containers, Kubernetes, entre outras.



Esta função envolve:

  • Manutenção de tecnologias existentes baseadas em Linux para ambientes on-premises.
  • Pesquisa, criação e desenvolvimento de aplicações — baseadas em charts do Kubernetes e/ou disponíveis na CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) — responsáveis por comunicação, busca otimizada em grandes volumes de dados, armazenamento de dados e mais, utilizando tecnologias e técnicas avançadas.
  • Manutenção de pipelines.
  • Melhoria do código por meio da adição de ferramentas para avaliação da qualidade do código.



RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Manter tecnologias existentes implantadas em vários países.
  • Implementar novas tecnologias para sistemas de medição de audiência com base em tecnologias existentes e novas.
  • Pesquisar novas tecnologias para aprimorar o produto.
  • Desenvolver novos serviços.
  • Criar novos charts do Kubernetes.
  • Garantir a comunicação dos containers Kubernetes dentro e fora dos clusters.
  • Manter a tecnologia atual.




REQUISITOS:


Essencial:

  • Superior completo ou cursando último ano na área de tecnologia.
  • Experiência com Linux / bash scripting.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em C++ and/or Golang
  • TDD – metodologia de testes
  • Experiência com SQL database e NoSQL database.
  • Inglês avançado para conversas técnicas e documentação.



Desejável:

  • Javascript
  • Kubernetes
  • AKS
  • Terraform
  • Monitoring systems
  • Prometheus Stack
  • Messaging (RabbitMQ)




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.


Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.


Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

title: Analista de Controladoria Sênior
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol. A empresa reúne a expertise complementar de dois pioneiros da indústria, um em tecnologias avançadas de lentes e outro na arte da fabricação de óculos icônicos, criando um negócio verticalmente integrado, única e exclusivamente posicionado para atender às necessidades de visão em constante evolução do mundo e à demanda global de uma indústria de óculos em crescimento. Com mais de 180.000 colaboradores em 150 países impulsionando nossas marcas icônicas, nossas pessoas são criativas, empreendedoras e reconhecidas por suas perspectivas e individualidades únicas. Comprometidos com a visão, nós capacitamos as pessoas a \"verem mais e serem mais\" graças aos nossos designs inovadores e tecnologias de lentes, qualidade excepcional e métodos de processamento de ponta. Todos os dias impactamos a vida de milhões de pessoas ao mudar a maneira como elas veem o mundo.


O analista irá realizar análises financeiras e de custos complexas, garantindo a acuracidade dos fechamentos mensais, projeções e indicadores. Atua como referência técnica para o time, suportando decisões estratégicas da fábrica e contribuindo para projetos de melhoria contínua, assegurando conformidade com políticas corporativas e normas contábeis.



  • Garantir a execução e qualidade do fechamento mensal de custos, realizando análises detalhadas de variações e tendências.


  • Elaborar e validar projeções (forecast) e suportar o processo de Budget anual, assegurando consistência e alinhamento estratégico.


  • Realizar análises avançadas de custos industriais, incluindo cálculo de novos produtos, business case industrial


  • Desenvolver relatórios gerenciais e dashboards com insights para tomada de decisão.


  • Participar de projetos de melhoria contínua e iniciativas de eficiência financeira.


  • Atuar como referência técnica para analistas plenos e juniores, apoiando na resolução de problemas complexos.





REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS

Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, engenharia ou áreas correlatas

Experiência em Controladoria de Custos




Conhecimentos Específicos / Habilidades

Excel avançado

SAP e Oracle (desejável)

Análise de custos e orçamentos

Inglês avançado (leitura e escrita; conversação intermediária)

Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (desejável)

title: Analista de Governança de TI Sênior
description:
Se você gosta de desafios e quer mostrar todo o seu potencial, queremos te conhecer! A Vericode preza por um time inclusivo e repleto de diversidade, nas suas mais variadas representações. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência!

#VemSerVericoder

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter políticas, normas, processos e procedimentos de Governança de TI e Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios, assegurando sua aderência as melhores práticas do mercado e regulamentações aplicáveis;
  • Atuar como ponto focal para assuntos que envolvam os processos de Gestão de Incidentes, Mudanças,
  • Problemas e Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios, assegurando sua execução eficaz e eficiente;
  • Desenvolver, testar e manter os documentos, diretrizes e procedimentos da Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios;
  • Avaliar e monitorar a eficácia dos controles de TI, identificando gaps e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Elaborar relatórios e indicadores de desempenho relacionados aos processos de Governança de TI mudanças, incidentes, problemas e continuidade de negócios;
  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo informações e implementando as recomendações;
  • Prestar suporte e orientação aos membros da equipe e outras áreas da empresa em relação as práticas da área de Governança de TI.
  • Planejamento e coordenação/análise de testes de recuperação de desastres (infraestrutura cloud e restore backup);
  • Análises de mecanismos de resiliência e continuidade de operações;
  • Criação e revisão/atualização de documentos relativos a GCN (plano de continuidade, planos de recuperação de desastres, contingência, dentre outros).

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa;
  • Sólida experiência em funções de Governança de TI com foco em Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios, Gestão de Incidentes, Mudanças e Gestão de Problemas;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de mercado como ITIL e/ou COBIT;
  • Experiência na elaboração e execução de Planos de Continuidade de Negócios e Planos de Contingência ou Recuperação de Desastres para ambientes de TI.
  • Experiência com BIA - Business Impact Analysis;
  • Certificação na norma ISO 22301 - Sistema de Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios.

Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Governança de TI, Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios, Segurança da Informação ou Gestão de Riscos
  • Certificação ISO 22301 – Sistema de Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios;
  • Certificação ISO 27001 – Sistema de Gestão de Segurança da Informação;
  • Certificação ISO 31000 – Gestão de Riscos;
  • Cursos relacionados aos frameworks de Governança de TI;
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação de frameworks de Governança de TI;
  • Experiência com Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios.

Informações adicionais:

Remuneração CLT


Benefícios:

  • Reembolso de Capacitações Técnicas: Cobertura de 100% para certificações profissionais, além de reembolso para cursos de capacitação técnica;

title: Pega Developer
description:
We are hiring an experienced Pega Developer to drive digital transformation initiatives across public sector programs.


This role sits at the core of mission-critical modernization efforts, combining deep technical expertise in Pega with system integration, workflow design, and scalable architecture. You will design and deliver secure, high-performance case management solutions that improve operational efficiency and service delivery for government agencies.

You will transform complex business requirements into robust Pega applications — integrating enterprise systems, modernizing legacy environments, and ensuring compliance with public sector standards. This person acts as a key technical partner to Architects, Business Analysts, QA, and Delivery teams.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and implement applications using the Pega Platform
  • Configure case types, workflows, user interfaces, data models, and business rules
  • Develop and test integrations using REST and SOAP APIs with enterprise and legacy systems
  • Collaborate with Architects, Business Analysts, and QA teams to ensure successful delivery
  • Execute unit, system, and integration testing, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
  • Participate in deployment planning, release management, and production support
  • Ensure compliance with public sector security and accessibility standards
  • Document technical specifications, configurations, and testing procedures


Required Experience & Skills:


  • 3+ years of experience in Pega application development
  • Experience working across full SDLC implementations
  • Strong knowledge of system integrations, APIs, and data management
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Advanced English (written and spoken)
  • Pega Certification (CSA, CSSA, or LSA)


Nice to have:


  • Experience with Federal or State/Local government projects
  • Familiarity with security and compliance standards


Why join Genesis Consulting:


  • Work on high-impact digital transformation projects in the public sector
  • Be part of a collaborative, mission-driven team
  • Opportunity for professional growth and development

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Roteirista e Copywriter — Conteúdo de Marca Pessoal (Freelancer)
description:
SOBRE A OPORTUNIDADE


Estamos contratando um roteirista e copywriter para um projeto de reposicionamento de marca pessoal de alto nível. O cliente é um advogado com 22 anos de carreira, presidente reeleito da OAB de um estado brasileiro, formado em Harvard, Berkeley e Singularity, que está fazendo a transição de figura política para líder de um movimento nacional sobre o futuro da advocacia.

O desafio é claro: traduzir uma tese intelectual profunda em conteúdo que fure a bolha, viralize e construa audiência. O cliente já tem toda a estratégia de posicionamento, discurso ideológico e arquitetura de canais definida. O que falta é quem transforme isso em roteiros executáveis que o façam encarnar esse novo posicionamento.

Você vai receber: Manual do Movimento (bíblia de marca completa), Código de Articulação (como transformar qualquer tema em conteúdo), Desdobramento de Canais (formatos, roteiros-modelo, cadernos de produção). Seu trabalho é usar esses documentos como base para criar roteiros que o cliente consiga gravar de forma natural e potente.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Criar roteiros para Reels de Reflexão (60-120s) com hooks virais para Instagram e TikTok
  • Escrever roteiros para Vlogs semanais no YouTube (20 min) em formato documentário
  • Produzir textos para Carrosséis de Dados (10 slides) com narrativa baseada em dados do CNJ
  • Escrever Artigos Analíticos longos para LinkedIn (tom de cronista, sem emojis, sem links)
  • Criar Posts Curtos para LinkedIn (um dado + uma tese, máximo uma tela de celular)
  • Produzir texto para o Vídeo Manifesto (60 - 90s) que inaugura o novo posicionamento
  • Entregar um stack inicial de 20-30 roteiros para sustentar o lançamento da nova linha editorial


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS


  • Experiência comprovada escrevendo roteiros para conteúdo de marca pessoal (portfólio obrigatório)
  • Habilidade de criar hooks virais e ganchos de atenção para Reels/TikTok
  • Capacidade de escrever tanto conteúdo curto (30s) quanto longo (artigos de 1000+ palavras)
  • Velocidade de entrega: capacidade de produzir 20-30 roteiros em 1-2 semanas
  • Português nativo com domínio de escrita formal e informal


REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS


  • Experiência com conteúdo para o segmento jurídico, institucional ou de educação executiva
  • Familiaridade com uso de IA (Claude) como ferramenta auxiliar de produção
  • Casos de conteúdo que atingiram +100k visualizações
  • Experiência adaptando voz/tom de experts ou líderes de opinião

title: Techno-Functional SQL Consultant
description:
***PLEASE APPLY WITH RESUME/CV WRITTEN IN ENGLISH TO DEMONSTRATE FLUENCY***


Title: Techno-Functional SQL Consultant

Location : Brazil (remote)

Working Hours : EST or CST


Must Haves:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or related discipline
  • 4+ years of experience in an application development or support role focusing on ERP or other backoffice applications (for example Oracle E-Business Suite or Oracle Cloud ERP or equivalent
  • Hands-on experience maintaining and supporting custom applications using Microsoft SQL Server
  • Demonstrated techno-functional expertise—understanding both business processes and technical configurations
  • Experience with author payments, royalties, or vendor payment systems HIGHLY PREFERRED
  • Proficiency in SQL and T -SQL
  • Experience with Data Integration tools (such as Informatica, SSIS or other), APIs, and Oracle Report
  • Strong understanding of business and financial workflows
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration abilities
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience with Oracle Cloud ERP Financials or migration from EBS to Cloud
  • Familiarity with publishing, media, or educational content industries


Key Responsibilities

  • This position will support the client’s Royalty application (SQL Server–based) and related integrations.
  • Serve as a liaison between Finance, IT, and business teams leveraging various back-office applications supporting the Product Lifecycle Management operations(the role will be primarily focused on Royalty application to start, then could shift to other applications and technologies in the future)
  • Monitor integration runs and proactively identify any delays and ensure accurate processing workflows
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL Server–based stored procedures, views, and reports supporting author payment and other supplier/vendor maintenance functionality
  • Troubleshoot and resolve both functional and technical issues across vendor/stakeholders, ERP (Oracle), and custom systems
  • Identify and coordinate issues arising between SQL Server-based application and other ERP (Oracle) applications
  • Support testing, upgrades, and system enhancements to ensure reliability and compliance
  • Document technical specifications, data flows, and business processes

Ensure data accuracy, internal control compliance, and timely payment execution

description:

Job Title: Oracle Fusion Cloud Techno‑Functional Developer

Location: Remote - sitting in Brazil

Working Hours: EST


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP
  • Hands‑on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
  • Experience developing and maintaining Oracle reports

  • Prior work in manufacturing, supply chain, or large corporate ERP landscapes
  • Exposure to additional Oracle Cloud services


Role Overview

Insight Global is seeking an Oracle ERP Techno‑Functional Developer with strong hands‑on experience across Oracle Fusion Cloud, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), and Oracle reporting. This role requires a blend of technical development skills and functional ERP knowledge, supporting integrations, reporting, and end‑to‑end ERP business processes.

The ideal candidate understands how ERP systems work functionally while also being capable of building, integrating, and supporting Oracle‑based solutions in a complex enterprise environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support and enhance Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP applications
  • Design, develop, and maintain Oracle reports to support business and operational needs
  • Build and support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand ERP functional processes and translate requirements into technical solutions
  • Support end‑to‑end ERP workflows, ensuring data accuracy and system reliability
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to ERP integrations, reports, and data flows
  • Collaborate with functional and technical teams in an Agile delivery environment

Venha fazer parte de um time inovador como como Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend .NET Pl, dentro de um ambiente que valoriza espírito empreendedor, autonomia, agilidade, foco no cliente, excelência e visão de longo prazo e inconformismo, num projeto de PIX, garantindo a segurança e eficiência das operações financeiras.

Vaga inicialmente temporária de 4 meses, com grandes chances de efetivação.


Necessário:

  • Experiência com .NET (C#)
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful
  • Experiência com Design Patterns
  • Experiência com testes unitários (TDD)
  • Experiência em GIT
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum)
  • Experiência em mensagerias (RabbitMQ/SNS/SQS)
  • Conhecimento em ambiente e serviços cloud.
  • Compromisso com qualidade de código.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de Code Quality (sonar) e monitoramento com Datadog.
  • Capacidade de escrever código robusto, testável e validado.


Soft skills:

  • Boa comunicação
  • Perfil colaborativo
  • Senso de dono
  • Comprometimento e responsabilidade com prazos e horários
  • Proatividade


Formação: Curso Superior Completo ou cursando em TI


Onde? Remoto

title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:
We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
About the Company


Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.



About the Role


We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance
  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way
  • Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively


Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check


Preferred

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools
  • Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment
  • Experience with AWS-based data environments
  • Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation
  • Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases
  • Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts


How to Apply

Please send your resume in English.

title: Finance Specialist
description:
Finance Specialist (Remote )

Location: Remote (Candidates must be based in France or eligible to work in France)

Employment Type: Full-time / Contract


Job Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Finance Specialist to manage financial operations, reporting, and compliance. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of French accounting standards, financial analysis, and regulatory requirements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage daily financial transactions, including accounts payable/receivable
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports
  • Ensure compliance with French GAAP and local tax regulations
  • Perform financial analysis, forecasting, and budgeting
  • Monitor cash flow and optimize financial performance
  • Assist with audits and liaise with external auditors
  • Maintain accurate financial records and documentation
  • Support payroll processing and expense management
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (HR, Operations, Sales)


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field
  • 3–7 years of experience in finance/accounting roles
  • Strong knowledge of French accounting standards and tax laws
  • Proficiency in financial software (e.g., SAP, Oracle, QuickBooks)
  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, financial modeling)
  • Fluent in French and English (mandatory)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional certifications (e.g., CPA, ACCA, or equivalent in France like DCG/DSCG)
  • Experience working in a remote or international environment
  • Knowledge of IFRS standards
  • Experience with ERP systems


Key Skills:

  • Financial Reporting
  • Budgeting & Forecasting
  • Compliance & Taxation
  • Data Analysis
  • Attention to Detail
  • Communication & Collaboration

title: Onboarding Specialist - Contractor
description:
About SleekFlow

Join SleekFlow, a thriving SaaS startup that is experiencing rapid growth globally thanks to the support of renowned investors like Alibaba Entrepreneurs Fund and Tiger Global. Our mission is to develop the next generation of Conversational AI, empowering customer interactions across all channels—from messaging to voice—and enhancing business workflows and processes.

You will have the opportunity to thrive alongside the company through equity options. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and assume a larger role, we look forward to meeting you!


At SleekFlow, we have developed an all-in-one Omnichannel Conversation AI Suite that drives conversions through conversations. Our platform seamlessly integrates with popular channels such as WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, WeChat, and more, providing comprehensive communication solutions. With our AI customer engagement platform, enterprises can automate growth by enhancing productivity across their sales, marketing, and support teams.

As we aggressively expand into emerging markets, we seek adventurous, diverse, and passionate individuals to join us on this exciting journey. Join our team and grow your career with SleekFlow!


Associate Level

Location: Brazil

Prior Experience in SaaS/ Software Industry is preferred

Language: Portuguese and business-level fluency in English


Responsibilities

  • Educating customers and optimizing their product setup for the quickest path to success.
  • Providing materials to help customers learn best practices to achieve their desired outcomes faster and more efficiently.
  • Work with sales, product, and support teams to ensure that each piece of the journey meets customer expectations.
  • Handle incoming enquiries via emails, calls and chats in a professional manner.
  • Build evergreen content and resources for customers (and other organizations) to use for education and to drive rapid product adoption.
  • Be a SleekFlow expert and discuss or educate on any nuance of the product internally and externally.
  • Work continuously to document the details of each interaction in order to easily research customer issues and to inform product improvements


Skills and Qualifications

  • Good command of both written and spoken Portuguese and English
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in communications, customer service and support, sales, account management, or customer success. Customer success courses / training are good to have.
  • Ability to learn, adapt and thrive quickly in a dynamic environment
  • Comfortable to engage with a diverse array of customers
  • Problem solving and critical thinking with detail oriented
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills (written & verbal)
  • Strong customer obsession attitude with evidence of taking independent and appropriate decisions for the customer
  • Strong computer skills, including CRM, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Team player with the desire to try new ideas in order to achieve greater levels of success


What We Offer

  • Competitive base package
  • 20 working days per month
  • Fun and diverse culture
  • International team environment
  • Constant & rigorous training from experience team leads


Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate.


SleekFlow is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

title: Multidisciplinary Creative
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You'll Do


  • Edit and produce video content across formats, social, brand, campaign, and everything in between.
  • Design compelling visual assets across digital and print, maintaining brand consistency and creative quality.
  • Lead and execute UI/UX work, from wireframes and user flows to polished, production-ready interfaces.
  • Leverage AI tools to enhance and accelerate creative output, from ideation to execution.
  • Collaborate with strategists, account managers, and developers to bring creative concepts to life across multiple channels.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously without dropping the ball on quality or deadlines.
  • Stay ahead of design trends, tools, and AI-powered workflows that keep our creative output cutting edge.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience across graphic design, video editing, and UI/UX, not just one of them.
  • A strong portfolio that proves you can move across disciplines without losing quality.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma, and Canva.
  • Real experience using AI tools in a creative workflow (image generation, video AI, copy assistance, etc.).
  • A solid eye for typography, layout, motion, and user experience.
  • Ability to take creative direction and run with it independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills, you know how to present your work and take feedback like a pro.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with Webflow or basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS).
  • Motion graphics or animation experience beyond basic video editing.
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Familiarity with AI design tools like Midjourney, ElevenLabs, or equivalents.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Handling major incidents via CIRS (Critical Issue Response System) and providing frequent updates until resolution.
  • Performing deep-dive application troubleshooting and identifying preventive actions.
  • Managing CIRS-related requests including deployments, feature toggles, and data fixes.
  • Following up on major production incidents and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
  • Enhancing monitoring capabilities using tools like Dynatrace, Kibana, and Splunk .
  • Writing and improving monitoring scripts and alerts based on incident learnings.
  • Handling customer escalations and coordinating with Support & Engineering teams.
  • Supporting planned activities and responding to ad-hoc requests from CES teams.


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Deep experience in DevOps and Production Support .
  • Experience in automation and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Splunk .
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to deep dive into application issues.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills across teams.


Please submit resumé in English.

title: Kneat System Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Kneat System Administrator .


In this role you will:

Serve as client’s dedicated Kneat expert, providing end-to-end system administration support across daily operations, issue resolution, configuration updates, enhancements, and business requests.

  • Configuration and enhancement deployment
  • System administration: role-based access control and data governance
  • Operational support and issue resolution
  • Assessing the current Kneat implementation to identify design and process gaps, and guiding re-architecture of templates, workflows, and configurations in line with best practices to ensure a scalable and compliant digital validation environment

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs consumed by Android and iOS clients
  • Build and maintain microservices using Java, Node.js, Python, or Go (per team stack)

title: Analista de Modelagem de Dados
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa para liderar a modelagem conceitual do domínio em contexto industrial, conectando arquitetura de dados a necessidades de negócio. Será responsável por entender projetos, abstrair processos e estruturar a camada de domínio e os use cases, colaborando com times multifuncionais e globais.


Principais atividades:

  • Conduzir a modelagem conceitual do domínio no contexto industrial, definindo entidades, relacionamentos e limites de contexto.
  • Derivar e estruturar use cases e modelos de domínio com base na arquitetura de dados corporativa.
  • Entender projetos e requisitos, abstrair processos e mapear para a camada de domínio e casos de uso.
  • Assegurar consistência e governança dos modelos, facilitando discussões técnicas com times globais.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em modelagem conceitual de dados e de domínio, preferencialmente em ambientes industriais.
  • Vivência em traduzir arquitetura de dados em modelos de domínio e casos de uso de negócio e técnicos.
  • Forte capacidade de abstração, comunicação e facilitação entre negócio, dados e engenharia.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (participação ativa em reuniões e workshops com times globais).


Informações adicionais:

  • Atuação remota

title: Consultor SAP FI Sênior - inglês avançado
description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa com propósito?


Fazer acontecer inspirando o melhor das pessoas está no DNA da nossa gente #Numen.


Prezamos por pessoas que:


Buscam comprometimento e excelência em suas entregas;


Criam e disseminam um ambiente colaborativo, com espírito de equipe, onde a amizade é valorizada;


Queiram atuar com profissionais de confiança;


E acreditam que o respeito e a humildade são essenciais para o seu dia a dia aqui na #Numen.


Se você se identifica com tudo isso e quer ser #Numen, não perca a oportunidade de participar desse processo seletivo


#VemSerNumen

Responsabilidades e Atribuições


Suas principais atividades serão: Participar de projetos de implementação, melhorias, rollout;

Executar as atividades de projeto de acordo com o planejamento: Desenho/detalhamento de soluções, configurações, testes, documentações, suporte ao cliente;

Suportar a preparação e realização dos testes integrados e de regressão aos usuários-chave e analistas de TI, para validação da solução implementada;

Elaborar as documentações requeridas pelo projeto: Configurações, testes, desenho/detalhamento de soluções, atas, especificações funcionais, apresentações, entre outros;

Treinar os usuários chaves e/ou analistas de TI;

Identificar oportunidades e propor soluções e melhorias;

Buscar conhecimento necessário para garantir a melhor solução; Mapear riscos técnicos do projeto; Propor/Realizar/Participar de treinamentos;

Cumprir as normas e procedimentos da Numen e seus clientes; · Desenvolver consultores menos experientes.


Requisitos e Qualificações


Aqui na Numen, você fará parte do time e terá oportunidade de se desenvolver participando de diferentes tipos de projetos, buscamos talentos que se identificam com os nossos valores e estão em busca de desafios em um ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor no qual é possível ensinar e aprender.


Desde a fundação em 2009 nosso crescimento é exponencial, resultado de projetos de sucesso em clientes conquistados ao longo dos anos.


Temos operações no Brasil, Estados Unidos e em Portugal.


Para se candidatar você precisa dos seguintes requisitos e qualificações:


· Sólidos conhecimentos em SAP FI

· Experiencia com migração de dados e integração.

· Participação em projetos de Implementação, Rollouts, Melhorias, Upgrades.

· Deve ter feito ao menos um projeto de implementação de ponta a ponta.


Imprescindível inglês avançado.

Criam e disseminam um ambiente colaborativo, com espírito de equipe, onde a amizade é valorizada;


Queiram atuar com profissionais de confiança;


E acreditam que o respeito e a humildade são essenciais para o seu dia a dia aqui na #Numen.

title: Senior IT Project Manager
description:
Senior IT Project Manager – Clinical & Life Sciences Technology

Location: Poland or Bulgaria or Brazil

Industry: Life Sciences | Clinical Technology | Software Platforms


We’re looking for a Senior IT Project Manager to lead the delivery of a cutting-edge clinical technology platform that supports risk-based quality management across global studies. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of IT, clinical operations, and regulatory compliance , helping life sciences organizations improve quality, efficiency, and oversight at scale.


What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex IT projects, ensuring success across scope, timeline, cost, quality, and value
  • Act as the primary client and business contact, building trusted relationships and ensuring stakeholder satisfaction
  • Lead cross-functional, matrixed, and global project teams (internal and external)
  • Develop and manage detailed project plans, budgets, resource models, and risk mitigation strategies
  • Proactively manage scope change, financial performance, and delivery risks
  • Ensure projects meet GxP, regulatory, and IT quality standards
  • Drive clear governance through steering committees, reporting, and KPIs
  • Support adoption of Agile and product-focused ways of working
  • Contribute to continuous improvement, documentation quality, and delivery best practices


What You Bring

  • 7+ years of IT project experience, including 2+ years leading full project lifecycles
  • Background delivering projects across clinical systems, enterprise solutions, infrastructure, or cybersecurity
  • Strong understanding of regulatory environments and quality-driven IT delivery
  • Proven experience managing budgets, forecasts, and financial performance
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfortable working independently in fast-paced, global environments


Nice to Have

  • Project Management, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or Program Management certifications
  • Experience with global or multi-region projects
  • Knowledge of GxP requirements for IT delivery
  • Prior experience in life sciences, clinical trials, or regulated software platforms
  • Master’s degree or advanced qualification


We are an equal opportunities Recruitment Business and Agency. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: SAP Basis Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um projeto global de grande porte no segmento de energia, com ambiente SAP robusto e crítico, composto por aproximadamente 15 sistemas produtivos ECC e S/4HANA

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Administração e configuração de ambientes SAP (Basis)
  • Suporte e sustentação de sistemas SAP (performance, interfaces e disponibilidade)
  • Troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes críticos
  • Monitoramento técnico e tuning de performance
  • Execução de rotinas de manutenção (RFCs, profiles, housekeeping, etc.)
  • Planejamento e execução de upgrades e melhorias
  • Gestão de backup & recovery
  • Atuação com replicação de dados (SLT)
  • Execução de testes de Disaster Recovery e Cyber Recovery
  • Participação em modelo Follow The Sun (FTS) para suporte global
  • Atuação em ambientes ágeis (squads, sprints, backlog - ADO)
  • Participação em escala de plantão (on-call rotativo)

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em SAP Basis
  • Vivência com SAP S/4HANA e SAP HANA Database
  • Experiência com SAP NetWeaver (ABAP e Java)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Solution Manager, Focused Run ou SAP LaMa
  • Experiência com troubleshooting, tuning e monitoramento de sistemas SAP
  • Conhecimento em backup & recovery
  • Experiência com replicação de dados (SLT)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais e suporte a banco de dados
  • Experiência com scripts (PowerShell ou Shell)
  • Vivência com gestão de incidentes, problemas e mudanças
  • Inglês avançado (atuação global)


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento em HANA Pacemaker
  • Experiência com ambientes de alta disponibilidade
  • Vivência em projetos globais e ambientes complexos
  • Perfil proativo e colaborativo
  • Facilidade para atuar em times ágeis

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office
